pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH single_donors AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors FROM donations), multi_donors AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") > 1), total_donations AS (SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_donations FROM donations) SELECT CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS BIGINT), 0), 1) * 100 / NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS BIGINT), 0), 1), 0) AS REAL) AS percent_donors, COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors FROM donations

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
WITH 
  single_donors AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors
    FROM donations
  ),
  multi_donors AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") > 1
  ),
  total_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_donations
    FROM donations
  )
SELECT 
  CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS BIGINT), 0), 1) * 100 / COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS BIGINT), 0), 1) AS REAL) AS percent_donors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS num_donors
FROM donations
